item.title: Ohio State Football Status Report: Tegra Tshabola Doubtful, Other Contributors Set to Play in Cotton Bowl
item.description: Ohio State is set to have its full complement of starters – outside one already confirmed as injured – when it plays Miami in the College Football Playoff on New Year's Eve. Right guard Tegra Tshabola has been listed as doubtful on all of the team's first three status reports leading up to the Cotton Bowl, but all of its other starters are currently available for Wednesday's game.
